result.summary: The image shows a residential corner with a significantly degraded sidewalk and a complete lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or street lighting visible, creating a neglected and inaccessible environment for walking.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk is heavily cracked, uneven, and littered with debris and vegetation, creating significant trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and left side of the image along the brick building.

hazards.name: Lack of ADA Accessibility
hazards.description: There are no curb ramps at the corner, creating a physical barrier for pedestrians with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner area in the immediate foreground.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repave the sidewalk to provide a smooth, level, and continuous walking surface free of debris and vegetation.

interventions.description: Install compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at the corner to ensure universal access.

interventions.description: Paint continental-style crosswalks to clearly delineate pedestrian space and improve driver awareness at the intersection.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, uncontrolled intersection in a residential neighborhood with significant infrastructure deficiencies. There are no marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or traffic calming measures, and the existing sidewalks are in poor condition with visible cracking and degradation.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks at a wide intersection increases pedestrian exposure and risk of conflict with vehicles.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: The wide, open road design without traffic calming likely encourages higher vehicle speeds and increases crossing time.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: Visible cracking and uneven pavement on the sidewalk create tripping hazards and accessibility barriers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the intersection corners to reduce crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and level the existing sidewalk surfaces to ensure a safe and accessible walking path.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a lack of basic safety infrastructure, including marked crosswalks and curb ramps. Significant visual obstructions from a stopped bus and parked cars, combined with the absence of traffic control devices, create a high-risk environment for crossing.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, providing no designated or protected space for pedestrians to cross.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Bus
hazards.description: The large bus stopped at the intersection blocks the line of sight between pedestrians and other approaching vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of ADA Accessibility
hazards.description: No visible curb ramps are present, creating barriers for people with mobility devices.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.
